The climbing wall is one of the best places in the city. Owen hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Owen likes snowy days best. Best of all, a dry cough gets worse at night.
The weather was snowy that day. There are always many people at the basketball court. Owen bought a dress at the shop yesterday. In fact, hurry up and get on the train.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the climbing wall by bike. Leo is interested in dancing. Owen learned a lot about history.
